jobs.name: momentum_01_launch_clip_a_v2
jobs.prompt: The folded royal blue cardstock polyhedron sits alone in the dark. Its outer panels fold inward one after another with springy mechanical momentum, each snapping shut and settling with a dampened overshoot, gold beads at the joints catching the rim light as they turn. The camera performs a slow sweeping crane arc, rising and moving left. Nothing else enters the frame at any point: no tools, no arms, no hands, no strings, no wires, no machinery. Hard key light from upper right stays fixed. Ends with the polyhedron closed and compact, still alone. No text, no logos, no people, no purple.

jobs.name: momentum_02_services_clip_a
jobs.prompt: The three flat-lay paper UI cards pop into place one after another, each scaling up from nothing with a snappy elastic ease and settling hard with almost no bounce, its soft drop shadow appearing with it: first the chart card, then the phone card, then the small map card. Camera is a locked orthographic top-down view with no movement. The beige watercolour paper stays still. Soft top-left light fixed. No text appears. Ends with all three cards at rest.

jobs.name: momentum_02_services_clip_b
jobs.prompt: Top-down on the paper map card. Three pins drop onto the map one after another from just above frame, each landing with a small squash and settle; the two navy pins first, the orange pin last. Then the list card beside it slides in from the right and stops with high friction and no overshoot, its orange-outlined row settling last. Camera locked orthographic. Soft top-left light fixed, shadows tracking each landing. No text appears. Ends still.

jobs.name: momentum_03_momo_clip_a
jobs.prompt: The blue sphere mascot sits still beside the cream phone, then its thin antenna wiggles twice, the yellow bead bobbing. Its white oval eyes blink once. It rotates about ten degrees toward the phone on its right, like a stop-motion turn, holds a beat, and turns back to face camera. The phone stays still and blank. Camera locked. Soft top-left light fixed, the drop shadow shifting slightly with the turn. Mascot proportions, eye spacing and antenna length stay exactly constant. Ends in the starting pose. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_03_momo_clip_b
jobs.prompt: Camera locked. The blue sphere mascot leans slowly toward the cream phone on its right, antenna tilting with it, as if peering at the blank screen, and holds the lean. Its eyes stay open and fixed on the phone. The phone does not move and stays blank. Soft top-left light fixed, cream cardstock still. Mascot proportions stay exactly constant. Ends holding the lean, both in frame. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_03_momo_clip_c
jobs.prompt: The small blue sphere mascot sits alone on cream cardstock, still. The yellow bead on its antenna brightens briefly like a tiny light and bobs. The mascot does one small vertical hop, squashing slightly on landing, and settles. Then it tilts its whole body a few degrees to one side, curious, and returns upright. Camera locked. Soft top-left light fixed, soft drop shadow following the hop. Proportions stay exactly constant. Ends in the starting pose. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_04_bumper_clip_a
jobs.prompt: The flat blue disc mascot sleeps leaning against the white cylinder, eyes drawn closed. Its eyes pop open suddenly. It does one snappy hop to the left with an energetic body wobble and head tilt, the curly antenna bouncing with secondary motion, then settles back against the cylinder with a dampened overshoot. Finally it blinks slowly back to a closed-eye smile, exactly as it began. Camera completely locked. Soft key from the right fixed, shadow following the hop. The cylinder never moves. Ends in the identical sleeping pose. No text.

jobs.name: momentum_04_bumper_clip_b
jobs.prompt: The flat blue disc mascot rests against the white cylinder, eyes open. It blinks once quickly, then rocks gently side to side about five degrees, the curly antenna swaying, and settles. It glances up and to the left, then back to camera. Camera locked. Light and shadow fixed, cylinder still. Ends in the starting pose. No text.
